rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is radically or entirely different.

example.english: After I changed jobs, my life was radically different.
example.traditional: 轉咗新工之後，我嘅生活完全唔同晒。
example.jyutping: zyun2 zo2 san1 gung1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 ge3 sang1 wut6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4 saai3

rows.note: Use this when “radically” means fundamentally or at the root, rather than simply to a high degree.

example.english: To solve this problem, we need to radically change the whole system.
example.traditional: 要解決呢個問題，根本上要改變成套制度。
example.jyutping: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gan1 bun2 soeng6 jiu3 goi2 bin3 sing4 tou3 zai3 dou6

rows.note: Use this slice when “radically” is being used in the sense of “very” or to mark a high degree.

example.english: This new phone is radically more expensive than the old one.
example.traditional: 呢部新手機非常貴，貴過舊嗰部好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 fei1 soeng4 gwai3 gwai3 gwo3 gau6 go2 bou6 hou2 do1
